#!/bin/bash

# collect_env.sh - Gather system architecture and user information

# Create build artifacts directory
mkdir -p build/artifacts

# Output to a hidden file in the build artifacts directory
OUTPUT_FILE="build/artifacts/.env_info.log"

{
echo "=== System Architecture ==="
uname -a

echo "\n=== CPU Info ==="
lscpu | grep "Model name\|CPU(s):"

echo "\n=== Memory Info ==="
free -h

echo "\n=== User Information ==="
whoami
id

echo "\n=== Current Directory ==="
pwd

echo "\n=== Environment Variables (first 10) ==="
env | head -10

echo "\n=== Collection Timestamp ==="
date

} >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"

echo "Environment information collected and appended to $OUTPUT_FILE"
